qs.q: Which factor is most directly associated with the re-emergence of mucormycosis during the COVID-19 pandemic?
o: Universal adoption of immunosuppressive biologic therapies
Widespread use of corticosteroids in diabetic patients
Massive administration of broad-spectrum antibacterial drugs
Global travel spreading endemic spores from the desert
qs.e: Mucormycosis re-emerged significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic particularly in diabetic patients on corticosteroids. These risk factors create a favorable environment for opportunistic fungal invasion.
